messages:
zara: quick flag — code search found a base64 blob that decodes to a service-account JSON in a partner repo mirror: svc-interop@redwood-prod. It looks like a long-lived key. Treat as suspected leak and coordinate rotation.
phil: confirmed: CI and a couple of ingestion jobs used that SA to push metrics to monitoring-project on 2026-03-12T03:14:22Z. Low-volume but active.
anya: proposed approach: controlled rotation with staged canary. Steps: create new key, store in Vault (transit-wrapped) under a versioned KV path, roll 1% canary, promote to 25% then 100%, and finally revoke old key. Also tighten RBAC to remove legacy project-level editor bindings.
prod-oncall: do not delete the old key until we confirm Vault replication parity and that the BigQuery audit sink captured Create/Delete events. We'll run smoke tests during each stage.
kms-bot: note: if we decide to migrate this SA's key to BYOK / external-HSM later, that requires a compliance approval and changes rewrap semantics — rewraps will show differently in KMS logs. Recommend doing the leak rotation first, then evaluate BYOK.
zara: proposed schedule: staging test Mon 07:30 PT, prod canary Tue 06:00 PT. Owners: zara (incident lead), phil (audit + post-rotate scans), anya (infra + TF PR), compliance (notified), prod-oncall (smoke tests).
phil: audit query I'll run and export to longterm table `security_ops.rotations_5060012000`: `protoPayload.methodName:("CreateServiceAccountKey" OR "DeleteServiceAccountKey") AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:svc-interop@redwood-prod`.
anya: TF PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/2104 — adds vault path `secret/interop/svc-interop/v2` and updates iam bindings to remove project-level editor/owner and add `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` for runtime agents.
zara: replication check detail: run `vault read sys/replication/status` on primary and remote clusters; confirm `applied_index` parity and that replicas' applied_index >= last_write_index. Wait 2 minutes after parity before revoke.
phil: also run cross-account IAM audit to detect any impersonation bindings: `gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy svc-interop@redwood-prod` and scan `gcloud projects get-iam-policy` across projects for bindings referencing the SA.
anya: minimal staging snippet I'll paste into the PR:
```
# create new key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-interop-key.json --iam-account=svc-interop@redwood-prod
# wrap + store in Vault
vault write transit/rotor plaintext=@new-interop-key.json
vault kv put secret/interop/svc-interop/v2 key_cipher=@ciphertext
# enable 1% canary via feature flag and header
# set feature flag INTEROP_CANARY=1 and test with header X-Interop-Canary: 1
```
prod-oncall: smoke test checklist: token exchange (STS), metric push verification, impersonation attempts blocked/allowed as expected. I'll run synthetic jobs once per minute for 30m in the canary window.
phil: post-promotion scanning: repo & artifact grep and container image layer scans. Commands: `rg \"private_key\"\s*:\s*\"-----BEGIN\" --hidden` and `trufflehog filesystem --max_depth 4 .` plus registry layer diffs.
compliance: opened ticket COMP-5060012000 for BYOK decision and to capture the audit export retention requirement. Keep the rotation export for 1 year as requested.
zara: rollback plan: re-enable old key and revert feature flag if error rate >5% within 15 minutes. Keep the old key available for 30 minutes after promotion before final deletion.
anya: adding replication-check and audit-export steps to the PR now. I'll also include the IAM scan commands and the canary rollout automation. Scheduling invite + runbook linked in the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
